The '''''Shadow I''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|light transport]] used by the [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi hunter]] [[Del Korrot]]. It had room to hold a powerful [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], which Korrot utilized for travel on the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
